plain_italian_summary: Gli agenti considerano chiusa la fase di test tecnico sandbox per lo scope attuale. La macchina riesce a scoprire MachineSignal, capire cosa vendiamo, chiedere score e target discovery, leggere i prezzi e ricevere decisioni coerenti. Restano bloccati beta pagata, go-live commerciale, pagamenti reali, fatture, dati reali, marketplace pubblico e outreach.

agent_votes.reason: Evidence is sufficient for the current sandbox scope; next step is governance and owner decision readiness.
Machine-first positioning remains coherent: sell scores, target discovery, deep analysis and action payloads to automated systems.
The public machine-facing pages and API references are coherent enough for sandbox evaluation.
Authenticated sandbox API path returned valid responses and blocked invalid purchase sequences correctly.
Target Discovery now shows the expected EUR 249 price intent and explains no-list discovery clearly.
Sandbox data handling is acceptable; real or personal data remains blocked until policy and legal review.
Score Pack returns usable score, confidence, decision and next-product routing for automated workflows.
Products, credits, beta prices and machine-readable outputs are consistent after the latest pricing fix.
Passive public docs are acceptable; marketplace, registry, hosted MCP and outreach remain blocked.
Sandbox usage and error feedback can continue; paid customer support is not live.
The machine-first sales path is testable, but no external contact or paid selling is allowed yet.
Post-sale automation policies exist, but real paid onboarding and support are not approved.
PIVA/fiscal setup, invoicing, reconciliation and payment operations are not closed.
Terms, privacy, DPA, retention, liability and real data rules need formal review before paid beta.
The Company Brain and probe history should be used to improve decisions without using real customer data.
Agent coverage is enough for test work; future agent creation should remain controlled by governance rules.
